What if Pac-Man was a horror game?

Pac-Man gets a horror remake where you are lost inside the maze with the lights off. Blinky, Pinky, Inky and Clyde move in total silence, and you only hear your own chomping. Would a Pac-Man horror game be terrifying or just funny?
